use_read_write_context: use the read_write context manager to temporarily modify a read-only OmegaConf configuration object
modify_readonly_config: modify a read-only OmegaConf config by wrapping changes in the read_write context manager
modify_struct_config: modify a struct-locked OmegaConf config by using the read_write context to disable struct mode
review_read_write: review the read_write context manager that temporarily disables readonly and struct flags on OmegaConf configs
test_read_write_context: test the read_write context manager to ensure readonly and struct flags are restored after exiting
